DISCHARGE SUMMARY Northern Lakes Regional Medical Center Page 1 of 4 Patient: OSTRANDER, WINIFRED M MRN: 5518204 DOB: 12/02/2020 Age: 73 Admit: 04/09/2094 Discharge: 04/12/2094 Unit: CCU -> Cardiac Step-down, Rm 5C-12 Attending: Dr. Marlon Tatum Cardiology: Dr. Yusuf Hart PCP: Dr. Lena Wojcik
DIAGNOSES: - Acute NSTEMI, s/p PCI (DES to mid LAD) 04/09 - Acute kidney injury vs CKD (Cr 3.0 on arrival, 1.2 at d/c) - Hyperlipidemia, LDL 193.7 - Prediabetes (A1c 6.0), anemia (Hb 12.4), obesity, osteoporosis
HOSPITAL COURSE: - Presented Fri w chest pain, trop+, ST depression. Heparin, ASA, clopidogrel load, taken to cath same day. 1 DES to LAD. Minimal contrast (30 ml). - TTE EF 45%, ant. hypokinesis. - Cr improved w fluids 3.0 -> 1.9 -> 1.2. Ramipril restarted 04/12, BMP in 1 wk. Nephrology saw, felt prerenal, outpt f/u. - WBC 3.3 on adm, 5.1 at d/c, no infxn. - Simvastatin stopped, atorvastatin 80 started. Alendronate remains OFF (stopped July 2092). - No arrhythmia, no bleeding. Ambulating w PT, stairs x 12 ok.
DISCHARGE MEDS: - aspirin 81 mg daily - prasugrel 10 mg daily (12 mo min) - metoprolol succinate 25 mg daily - atorvastatin 80 mg nightly - ramipril 10 mg daily - nitroglycerin 0.4 mg SL prn
SOCIAL / DISPO: - Home w husband Harlan (74) at 2216 Birchwood Lane, Unit 4, Duluth MN. Third floor walk-up. Landlord Mr. Pruitt aware, has fixed stairwell light. - Daughter Gwendolyn staying through Sunday the 18th; son Rory coming for weekend. - Neighbor Tilly Brandvolt to bring meals. - Pt's mother (94 yo, ninety-four) at Pine Hollow Care Center told by daughter; pt wishes to visit once cleared. - Former employer Lakeshore Linen Service sent flowers (pt retired 2090). - Follow up: Dr. Hart 2 wks, Dr. Wojcik 1 wk, cardiac rehab (218) 555-0190, ext x4417.
